name: BrandCollage
description: The brand pane's collage: a BrandIllustration and agent faces laid around it like stickers. It says nothing in particular and doesn't change with what the person types. Decorative: hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: children
props.description: Agent faces: four or five `Avatar type="agent"`, lg or md. They take the five places in order (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left, bottom); a sixth and later are not drawn.
